messages:
Sam (Support): ping CS — ArcadiaPay trial hitting degraded embeddings latency and ~20% 502s on hosted API. Renewal check-in next week; this is a renewal-risk signal. Need urgent CS intake + comms. Request id 6349, org=arcadia-pay-prod. Can CS lead customer-facing comms and request a temporary capacity bump?

Jordan (CS): on it. Can you paste a short repro and any rate/quota changes? I'll schedule a 30m enablement call today evening and draft a comms plan. Flagging renewal risk.

Sam (Support): repro + error snippet below:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"..."}'
# response: 502 backend read timeout
```
Spike observed after large ingest at ~11:12 UTC. No recent quota change on their end.

Eli (CS Ops): quick ops note — temporary capacity bump needs finance pre-approval if >2h. Suggest comms structure: 1) acknowledge, 2) immediate mitigation (reroute to fallback smaller-embedding model), 3) schedule enablement call, 4) offer temporary capacity bump + follow-up RCA. I can draft customer email.

Priya (Solutions Eng): tech note — looks like KV cache pressure / worker saturation on the embeddings pool. Eng-runtime should check autoscaler + kernel OOMs. Short-term options: route to fallback quantized model or increase per-tenant burst capacity. Tagging eng-runtime.

eng-runtime-bot: Alert forwarded to eng-runtime-team (corr_id=abc123). If no ack in 15m, paging oncall.

Jordan (CS): Plan: I will 1) send comms draft to Sam & Eli by 20:00 UTC, 2) schedule 30m call at 21:00 UTC today, 3) request a 2-hour capacity bump as interim pending eng confirmation. Sam — can you confirm primary contact and whether fallback routing is allowed?

Sam (Support): contact is kate@arcadiapay.com (CTO). Kate previously approved fallback routing in writing last week. Customer ok with temporary bump — will DM legal for quick sign-off if needed.

Eli (CS Ops): preparing billing note + one-off capacity proposal. Draft comms (edit):
"Hi Kate — we see elevated latency for embeddings. Immediate mitigation: temporary reroute to a smaller embedding model + short capacity bump while we investigate. Proposed 30m call at 21:00 UTC to align on steps and next-day RCA."

Jordan (CS): assigning owners: Jordan = CS lead (customer comms + call), Eli = ops (billing & capacity request), Priya = SRE contact (eng-runtime liaison), Sam = support liaison (logs & customer approvals). Will post updates after the call. :thumbsup:
